servinfo.title: Side Rear Seat Belt Assembly Removal and Installation

attention1.ptxt: For 10-channel air bag system, failure to take proper precautions when servicing seat belt pretensioner may result in personal injury.

item.ptxt: Do not disassemble or repair seat belt components. If any abnormalities are found, replace the seat belt components with a new replacement set.
Before servicing the seat belt, read Precautions for Service and Diagnosis of Seat Belt and follow all the instructions provided.

attention3.ptxt: For 10-channel air bag system, refer to Repair and Inspection Required after Accident before replacing an activated pretensioner.

s1.ptxt: For 10-channel air bag system, disable air bag system.
Remove rear quarter inner lower trim.
For 10-channel air bag system, disconnect rear seat belt pretensioner connector (1) from rear seat belt pretensioner (2) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Release lock button (3) by pulling it in arrow direction “1”.
Disconnect rear seat belt pretensioner connector with lock released by pulling it in arrow direction “2”.

s1.ptxt: Remove rear seat belt bolts (4), and then remove rear seat belt assembly.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Fit claw (2) on seat belt pretensioner (1) into cutout (3) on body panel.
Tighten bolts of rear seat belt assembly in numerical order to specified torque.
For 10-channel air bag system, connect rear seat belt pretensioner connector (4) to rear seat belt pretensioner as follows.
Connect rear seat belt pretensioner connector to seat belt pretensioner with lock button (5) released by pushing it in arrow direction “1”.
Press lock button to lock connector securely by pushing it in arrow direction “2”.
Do not step on vehicle bead (2) when installing anchor plate (1).
Fit tab (3) of right-side and center rear seat belt buckle (4) to hole (5) of floor panel.

entry.ptxt: Side rear seat belt assembly and left-side rear seat belt buckle
Right-side and center rear seat belt buckle

item.ptxt: For 10-channel air bag system, enable air bag system.
